query:
SELECT r.flow, r.outcome, r.ended_at, r.scored_at, r.definition_evaluation,
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM factory_benchmark_trial t WHERE t.run_id = r.id
                ) AS "trial!",
                ARRAY(
                    SELECT s.scorer FROM factory_run_score s
                    WHERE s.run_id = r.id
                    ORDER BY s.scorer
                ) AS "judged!"
            FROM factory_run r
            WHERE r.id = $1
